source_name: SEE Legal – Kosovo member page
why_relevant: Alliance of leading South-East European firms; its Kosovo page identifies which regional firm covers Kosovo and links to the member's own publications, a cheap way to keep the actor map of professional interpreters current.

source_name: Legal 500 – Kosovo rankings and country profiles
why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of the Kosovo law-firm population, including Deloitte Legal shpk and RPHS Law, with practice-area breakdowns. Use it to build and refresh the actor map of firms that could publish banking/payments alerts, and to find their canonical websites.

source_name: Chambers and Partners – General Business Law, Kosovo
why_relevant: Second independent directory of Kosovo firms; Chambers also hosts Practice Guides whose Kosovo chapters are firm-written regulatory overviews (a compact, dated summary of the banking/AML framework).

source_name: IFLR1000 – Kosovo firm profiles (financial and corporate)
why_relevant: IFLR1000 ranks specifically on banking/finance and capital markets, so its Kosovo entries isolate exactly the firms whose alerts matter to this workstream, and its deal lists reveal which firms sit closest to bank clients.

source_name: ITR World Tax – Deloitte Kosovo and peer tax-firm profiles
why_relevant: Maps the Kosovo tax-advisory population (Deloitte Kosova, and peers), which is the community that publishes fiscalization and tax-procedure deadline alerts. Useful to complete the Big Four / next-tier actor map.

source_name: KPMG Albania & Kosovo – Pristina office and insights
why_relevant: KPMG has operated in Kosovo via its Pristina office since 2005, providing Tax & Legal services within the KPMG Balkans cluster. Its Albania-hosted insights/tax-news stream is the likely carrier of any Kosovo tax & legal alerts; the exact Kosovo alert index path was not confirmed in this run.

source_name: EY Albania (covering Kosovo) – Tax Alerts
why_relevant: EY has a Kosovo entity in Pristina (Ernst & Young Certified Auditors Ltd Kosovo shpk) served from the Albania hub, and EY's global technical tax-alert library contains at least one Kosovo-titled alert PDF (2025 series), indicating a repeatable Kosovo alert channel.

source_name: Grant Thornton Kosovo – tax and advisory insights
why_relevant: Next-tier audit firm with a standalone Kosovo domain and a Kosovo tax practice; the Grant Thornton global indirect-tax guide already carries a Kosovo chapter describing invoice/fiscal-number requirements and TAK EDI VAT filing — directly relevant to fiscalization obligations.

source_name: Oda e Avokatëve të Kosovës (Kosovo Bar Association) – legislation section
why_relevant: The professional body for Kosovo advocates; its legislation section and member directory are the authoritative Albanian-language route to identify practising firms/advocates and any bar-issued guidance, and it is a native-language pointer into the interpreter community rather than an English marketing layer.

source_name: Ligji-KS – Albanian-language access layer to the Official Gazette
why_relevant: A private 'easy access to the Kosovo Official Gazette' service — the interpreter layer between gzk.rks-gov.net and practitioners. Useful as an sq-language change-detection surface for banking/payments/AML laws and as a cross-check on which acts practitioners are actually consulting.

source_name: Hoxha & Associates (Prizren/Kosovo) – law firm site
why_relevant: Kosovo firm surfaced through an Albanian-language query; bilingual site covering business and contract law. Lower-tier for banking specifically, but part of the domestic sq-language interpreter layer worth a periodic check for commercial-law commentary.

source_name: Legalis Kosovo – legal services firm site
why_relevant: Prishtina-area legal services provider found via Albanian-language search; candidate for the domestic sq/en interpreter layer. Publication stream not confirmed — treat as a lead requiring triage.

source_name: KALLXO.com (BIRN Kosova) — tag: Banka Qendrore e Kosovës [BQK]
why_relevant: BIRN Kosova's investigative desk is the outlet most likely to expose supervisory failures, unpublished draft rules, licensing disputes and enforcement actions the regulator publishes tersely. The BQK tag page acts as a persistent, low-noise feed of every BQK-related story.

source_name: KALLXO.com — 'lajm' news stream (legislation and government approvals)
why_relevant: Kallxo reports government/parliament approvals of draft laws (e.g. 'Qeveria miraton Projektligjin ...', 'Miratohet Ligji ...') often on the day of the cabinet session — a fast surfacing layer for legislative deadlines relevant to banking and payments.

source_name: Ekonomia Online — Kosovo specialist economic news portal
why_relevant: Dedicated economics desk that routinely covers BQK publications (Financial Stability Report), banking-sector statistics, and legal/regulatory changes affecting banks — the closest thing Kosovo has to a specialist financial trade press in Albanian.

source_name: KOHA.net — Ekonomi section (Koha Ditore group)
why_relevant: Kosovo's paper-of-record newsroom; covers BQK positions on draft banking law ('BQK: Ligji për bankat të ndjekë standardet e BE-së'), interest-rate and supervisory incidents (e.g. the Banka Ekonomike cyber incident and BQK's response). Strong for regulator statements and parliamentary hearings.

source_name: Telegrafi — Ekonomi section
why_relevant: Highest-traffic Albanian-language portal; publishes BQK press material near-verbatim and fast — including SEPA accession status, BQK's Annual Report submission to the Assembly, and inter-institutional supervision/information-sharing agreements. Useful as an early tripwire even though it is largely a republisher.

source_name: Insajderi — Gazeta Online INSAJDERI
why_relevant: Covers the political mechanics around BQK — notably the stalled parliamentary election of a new Governor and BQK Board decisions, with direct sourcing from the BQK spokesperson. Governance/appointment risk is an early indicator of supervisory capacity.

source_name: Dukagjini.com — economy/politics desk
why_relevant: Reported the government's approval of the Draft Law on Payment Services with the Finance Minister's framing (cost reduction, SEPA alignment, consumer protection) — directly on-topic for the payments regulatory pipeline.

source_name: Bota Sot — Ekonomi section
why_relevant: Has carried explicit BQK enforcement/inspection signalling ('BQK: Do t'i hetojmë bankat komerciale për rritje të tarifave') — i.e. supervisory-dispute stories about fees, a recurring conduct-regulation theme.

source_name: Ekonomia.info
why_relevant: Second Albanian-language economics portal; observed covering consumer-protection advances in banking services ('Avancohet mbrojtja e konsumatorëve në shërbimet bankare'), a conduct-regulation topic in scope.

source_name: Kosova.info — economy/finance coverage
why_relevant: Carried BQK Governor Ismaili's ECB engagement and EU financial-integration framing — useful for tracking the EU-alignment driver behind Kosovo's regulatory pipeline (SEPA, EU-standard banking law).

source_name: Urgjent.com — Kosovo news, cash-payment rule coverage
why_relevant: Surfaced the effective-date rule that from 1 June 2026 person-to-person payments above EUR 2,000 must go through a bank — exactly the kind of hard compliance deadline this workstream tracks, often reported by second-tier outlets before it is widely noticed.

source_name: Prishtina Insight (BIRN Kosova, English edition)
why_relevant: BIRN's English outlet carries the deepest investigative work on the banking regulator (governor arrest investigation, euro-only policy and illicit flows, AML intelligence network). Complements the Albanian Kallxo feed and is the version most likely to be citable in an English deliverable.

source_name: Balkan Insight — Prishtina bureau (BIRN regional)
why_relevant: Regional BIRN desk covering Kosovo banking politics with cross-border framing — e.g. commercial banks implementing the euro-only rule and the closure of Serbia-linked banks/payment points, which is the single most contentious supervisory dispute in the market.

source_name: KoSSev — North Kosovo portal (Serbian, with Albanian mirror)
why_relevant: The essential Serbian-language counterweight for this cell: covers licensing status of Serbian banks in the Kosovo system, CBK statements on unlicensed institutions, and government/legislative decisions (e.g. the 2026 budget). Albanian-language outlets systematically under-report the Serb-bank supervisory dispute.

source_name: BQK press/news page — primary anchor for media triangulation
why_relevant: Not a media source, but the required corroboration anchor for this cell: every media claim about a new rule, consultation or enforcement action must be checked here. Also the source most media outlets republish verbatim, which lets the pipeline deduplicate.
